data.title: Technical Controller
data.description:
About Us: At Booking.com, data drives our decisions. Technology is at our core. And innovation is everywhere. But our company is more than datasets, lines of code or A/B tests. We’re the thrill of the first night in a new place. The excitement of the next morning. The friends you encounter. The journeys you take. The sights you see. And the memories you make. Through our products, partners and people, we make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

 

Role Description:

 

We are seeking an enthusiastic Technical Accounting Specialist to join our Technical Accounting & Oversight team. This role is primarily focused on US GAAP and SEC technical accounting topics and related projects.

Based at our headquarters in Amsterdam, you will be part of a dynamic organization of finance professionals and report to the Head of Technical Accounting & Oversight for Booking.com. You will also interact regularly with our Group teams in the US and the UK.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide US GAAP accounting guidance to other finance teams regarding  new initiatives, products, and non-recurring transactions.

  • Document and review technical accounting assessments in line with US GAAP.

  • Oversee the accounting function, ensuring accurate and proper accounting by developing and maintaining a deep understanding of key financial statement line items.

  • Drive continuous improvement through standardization, process creation, automation, and task simplification.

  • Act as a key partner to Financial Controllers and other core Finance departments (including FP&A, Risk & Control, Business Units, Tax, Treasury, and Reporting).

  • Undertake ad-hoc tasks and projects as requested by the manager.

Ideal Candidate Profile:

  • Solid expertise in US GAAP and SEC reporting. 

  • Strong comprehension of other functional Finance areas such as Risk & Controls, SOX, Financial Systems, and Compliance. 

  • Ambitious, inquisitive, keen to develop, and ready to take on additional responsibilities.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, especially in stakeholder management.

Required Qualifications & Experience:

  • University degree in Accounting, Business, or Economics, and/or postgraduate education (e.g., RA/CPA/ACCA).

  • Approximately 8-10 years of experience in finance and/or accounting.

  • Sound knowledge of US GAAP (IFRS experience is beneficial).

  • Experience in a Big 4 Audit firm.

  • Proven ability to work effectively in a team within an international, matrix organization.

  • Enthusiastic about innovation and process improvement.

  • Fluent in both spoken and written English.

Benefits & Perks - Global Impact, Personal Relevance:

 

Booking.com’s Total Rewards Philosophy is not only about compensation but also about benefits. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, as well unique-to-Booking.com benefits which include:

  • Annual paid time off and generous paid leave scheme including: parent, grandparent, bereavement, and care leave

  • Hybrid working including flexible working arrangements, and up to 20 days per year working from abroad (home country)

  • Industry leading product discounts - up to 1400 per year - for yourself, including automatic Genius Level 3 status and Booking.com wallet credit

Inclusion at Booking.com: 

 

Inclusion has been a core part of our company culture since day one. This ongoing journey starts with our very own employees, who represent over 140 nationalities and a wide range of ethnic and social backgrounds, genders and sexual orientations. 

 

Take it from our Chief People Officer, Paulo Pisano: “At Booking.com, the diversity of our people doesn’t just build an outstanding workplace, it also creates a better and more inclusive travel experience for everyone. Inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. It’s a place where you can make your mark and have a real impact in travel and tech.” 

 

We ensure that colleagues with disabilities are provided the adjustments and tools they need to participate in the job application and interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

 

Application Process:

  • Let’s go places together: How we Hire

Booking.com is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We strive to move well beyond traditional equal opportunity and work to create an environment that allows everyone to thrive.


Pre-Employment Screening

If your application is successful, your personal data may be used for a pre-employment screening check by a third party as permitted by applicable law. Depending on the vacancy and applicable law, a pre-employment screening may include employment history, education and other information (such as media information) that may be necessary for determining your qualifications and suitability for the position.

The Booking.com FP&A team has an exciting career opportunity open in the Strategic Partnerships FP&A team. Below is a general description of job responsibilities of a Financial Analyst at Booking.com:
This position offers the opportunity to drive financial decision making within Booking.com. We are currently looking for an entrepreneurial Financial Analyst to be part of the dynamic and fast-paced Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) team. In this role you will report to the Senior Manager of FP&A for Strategic Partnerships . You will be working in our office in Manchester. 
You will be required to provide strong financial and analytical support to your business unit (BU) or department’s stakeholders. You will have to bridge what the data tells you and how that could help decision-making on a wide array of topics.
You will be supporting the Strategic Partnerships department as a key finance business partner, supporting decision making and also supporting on ad-hoc analyses whenever there is a need from the business.
Due to the rapid and continuous growth of the organization, the tasks and duties of this role will evolve over time. You will be keen to develop and grow within the role and challenge yourself to take on additional projects and responsibilities as they present themselves.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Monitor and analyze our trading performance across the department, develop insights, and support trading analysis processes within the business and with other marketing channels
  • Delivery of financial results on an ongoing basis to the BPD corporate FP&A team
  • Support with forecasting, variance analysis and reporting of financial performance for SP/BPD;
  • Contribute to robust, scalable and insightful reporting of the business unit or department’s key metrics;
  • Provide financial and analytical support into business cases & deal evaluation for the department
  • Support a variety of stakeholder groups to deliver projects to improve the profitability and efficiency of the department.
  • Ownership of group wide reporting to the Booking holdings group along with any cross brand activities.
  • Adhoc analytical support and scenario modelling for the Commercial, Product, Tech and Ops business owners along with wider team support projects
  • Continuously seek ways to improve and optimize the existing reporting to fit with evolving requests from senior management.

Required Qualifications & Experience:

 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business/Finance or other related field (preferred);
  • 5+ years’ experience in a similar role;
  • Strong financial modeling and analytical skills;
  • High attention to detail and ability to connect the dots and reconcile multiple data sources;
  • Strong communication skills and ability to present to different audiences;
  • Self-driven mentality, proactively seeking to find solutions to problems and providing the best analytics possible to key decision makers
  • Advanced knowledge of Excel;
  • Experience with SQL, data mining, Microsoft VBA and reporting tools;

About the role

 

We are looking for an independent and enthusiastic Controller within the Statutory Accounting Team in Amsterdam. The Statutory Accounting team is responsible for the preparation of statutory accounts of local legal entities, as well as the largest and most complex consolidation (100+ entities) within the global Booking group.


Your understanding of Dutch/US GAAP accounting, experience with preparation of complex
consolidated Financial Statements, exposure to other functional finance areas (external audit/ tax/ technical accounting), in combination with strong communication skills and stakeholder management, will enable you to be successful in this role.


The Statutory Accounting team is part of the Global Booking Accounting Organization, and you will work with the Corporate and Regional accounting teams, Booking Center of Excellence (COE) in India, and various other stakeholders (Treasury, Legal, Tax, External auditors) in finance and business.

 

The role offers insight and development possibilities within both the Statutory Accounting and Tax Compliance & Accounting teams.
Strong communication, stakeholder management, Dutch accounting and analytical skills are
essential. You will be able to develop yourself, grow within the role, and challenge yourself to take on additional projects and responsibilities as they present themselves.


Key Job Responsibilities and Duties

 

  • Prepare the accounting/reporting bridge between US- and NLGAAP for each local entity
  • Prepare NLGAAP consolidation bridge between US- and NLGAAP
  • Manage the preparation of Consolidated annual financial statements (including
    disclosures)
  • Support the calculation of maximum distributable reserve for interim dividend
    distributions in line with the Dutch Civil Code
  • Regular review of P&L accounts in view of potential US-NLGAAP reconciling items
  • Review, analysis, and documentation of accurate Dutch accounting treatment of new
    initiatives, products, and non-recurring transactions.
  • Collaborate with Controllers, COE, Tax accounting, and other key finance departments
    such as FP&A, Treasury, Internal Audit, Risk and Control, etc.
  • Take ownership and ensure accuracy of recurring reporting tasks and reviews
  • Support and prepare recurring and ad-hoc stakeholder reports
  • Drive process automation, standardization and simplification
  • Support Direct/Indirect Tax Accounting teams when and if required
  • Contribute to the overall success of the Statutory accounting team

Please note that this list of duties is not exhaustive, and you may be required to complete ad-hoc tasks as requested by your manager.

  • University (Accounting, Business, Economics) degree and/or postgraduate education

  • Approx. 5-7 years of experience in finance and/or accounting, preferably within a Big4 environment in combination with multinational corporate environment
  • Strong knowledge of Dutch GAAP/IFRS (USGAAP is a plus)
  • Good knowledge of Dutch tax (fiscal unity) is a pre
  • Experience in preparing the consolidated accounts and/or consolidation adjustments
  • Strong IT experience in financial systems, including SAP (S4) and OneStream, is
    preferable
  • High levels of personal effectiveness, particularly communication, organization, and the ability to focus on achieving project deadlines
  • Enthusiasm to work in a fast paced, highly diverse, continuously developing and high
    achieving environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and stakeholder management

data.description:

Department & Team Overview

This role is part of the Digital Partner Ecosystem (DPE), which helps accommodation partners get more value from Booking.com through connected, intuitive, and scalable digital experiences. DPE combines partner-facing platforms, content, product marketing, commercial advice, education, and self-service support to make it easier for partners to understand, adopt, and use our products and services throughout their partnership lifecycle.

 

By reducing friction and providing clear, relevant, and personalised guidance at the right moment, DPE enables partners to manage their business more effectively, grow their performance, and ultimately contribute to Booking.com’s top-line results. The department develops and delivers digital strategies across content marketing, product marketing, go-to-market, platform experience, and AI-enabled solutions - creating consistent, measurable, and increasingly self-service ways for partners to engage with us.

 

Our target audience is all accommodation partners globally who are currently partnered with, or in the process of partnering with, Booking.com. DPE teams support partners across every stage of their journey, making it easier to discover opportunities, understand our products, complete key tasks, find answers, and take action through our digital platforms and channels.

 

The Lead GenAI Conversational Interfaces drives the continuous improvement and optimization of a defined scope within the Digital Partner Ecosystem's conversational AI product portfolio (currently covering search experiences, agents as well as the underlying RAG infrastructure). 

 

This role owns the performance, quality, and evolution of partner-facing conversational interfaces through content and related infrastructure enhancements - including knowledge architecture optimization, skills and evaluation framework management, and information retrieval systems.

 

Grounded in partner feedback and conversation data analysis, they deliver measurable improvements in partner self-service adoption, answer quality, and support efficiency while maintaining compliance with content governance and safety standards. 

 

Operating within a collaborative framework, this role partners closely with fellow leads across distinct areas of the GenAI portfolio, Partner Support, Partner Hub backend and infrastructure, UX, as well as engineering, machine learning, data science, content, and legal/compliance teams. Clear scope definition and cross-functional alignment ensure efficient collaboration and avoid duplication across the GenAI product portfolio. 

 

Key Job Responsibilities and Duties 


Ownership: Scope

Drive the impact of partner-facing conversational AI on the Hub (Smart Search, Support Agent) through content and related infrastructure enhancements — including knowledge architecture optimization, skills and evaluation framework management, and information retrieval improvements. Focus on channel performance, partner experience quality, and content governance — aligned with department priorities and the innovations roadmap.

Ownership: Performance / Impact

Track and improve conversational AI KPIs — answer quality, task completion, self-service adoption, contact reduction, and partner satisfaction — identifying tactics/opportunities by diving into partner conversations, feedback, and operational data. 

Use human-in-the-loop evaluation and in-product measurement to identify recurring issues, own the continuous feedback-to-improvement loop, and discover insights and opportunities for quality and operational health; not relying solely on automated judge scores.

Backlog Management

Own and prioritise the conversational AI channel backlog — including quality improvements, content guidelines work, measurement implementation, and partner experience enhancements — based on partner needs, business impact, technical feasibility, and compliance requirements. Align across the team on priorities across shared resources.

Partner Impact & Feedback Loop
Monitor live sessions and partner feedback for recurring pain points or quality gaps; resolve directly within own scope, and pass signals with innovation or roadmap implications to cross-functional leads and other key stakeholders.

Voice of the Partner

Represent the partner perspective decisions — incorporating partner feedback, session data, and content quality signals into solution design, and advocating for experiences with customer centricity. 

Vendor / Budget Management

Coordinate and challenge internal and external contributors across product, engineering, data science, content, and vendor teams with clear requirements, priorities, and quality expectations.

 

Role Qualifications and Requirements 

  • Proven experience (4+ years) in Product Operations, Product Management, or Technical Program Management, with proven focus on driving continuous improvement and performance optimization of Conversational AI products in production.

  • AI Operations & Continuous Improvement - Proven track record of running the day-to-day operations of a live AI/conversational product, driving continuous quality and content improvements based on real usage and partner feedback.

  • Content & Prompt Execution - Hands-on experience writing and iterating on prompts, dialogue flows, and AI-served content at scale; understands how content and prompt changes affect AI output and can execute improvements directly, not just define standards for others.

  • Business Acumen - Frames day-to-day work in terms of answer quality, self-service rates, and contact reduction; connects fixes and improvements to DPE commercial metrics and CS outcomes.

  • Data-Driven Evaluation — Comfortable designing and interpreting AI quality evaluations, including human-in-the-loop frameworks, session analysis, and in-product measurement — not reliant solely on automated judge scores.

  • Content & Conversational Governance — Understands how content quality and guidelines affect AI output; experience working with content teams to define and maintain standards for AI-served or AI-generated content at scale.

  • Stakeholder Communication — Bridges technical and non-technical audiences; experienced in positioning AI work internally and translating complex technical concepts into clear business value propositions.

  • Project Management — Methodical in breaking down complex cross-functional work and delivering against timelines independently.

  • Technical Literacy — Understands knowledge architecture, retrieval systems, skills frameworks, evaluation methodologies, and GenAI infrastructure (RAG, LLM evaluation, model updates) well enough to challenge and prioritize technical decisions and scope boundaries without owning the underlying infrastructure implementation

Leadership/Team Quote:

Booking.com’s Fintech team is pivotal in developing scalable, compliant, and innovative solutions to support our partners and ensure adherence to global regulatory frameworks. Within this team, the RegTech function is responsible for creating and maintaining the technical architecture that underpins critical processes such as Know Your Customer (KYC), Proof of Address (POA), and Know Your Business (KYB). We are seeking a Senior Commercial Associate – RegTech with regulatory compliance experience, either within commercial operations in Financial Services or within Sales/Account/Project management. You will support the Senior Commercial Manager and work closely with Product and Tech teams to ensure seamless partner experiences and operational excellence.



Role Description:

As a Commercial Associate – RegTech, you will play a supporting role in managing key partner relationships, acting as advisor on compliance requirements, collaborating with cross-functional teams to enhance systems and processes that support partner verification and compliance. This role requires an understanding of KYC/KYB, Screening and other SAAS Compliance tools. Specific regulatory knowledge of PSD3, AMLR/AMLA and EIDAS 2.0 within the EEA context is highly desirable. The ability to support the management of numerous stakeholders (internal and external) with competing priorities; is key to success in this role.

  • Provide support to the Senior Commercial Manager liaising with (e.g., RegTech, Supplier Fraud Teams) and external vendors to optimize KYC, POA, and KYB solutions, and other Financial Crime solutions, ensuring regulatory compliance

  • Determine and support the input and outputs of a variety of POCs (Proof of Concepts) with prospective vendors - including detailed dat analysis

  • Support the execution and development of commercial strategies with vendors to achieve cost optimizations, expand services, and support Booking.com’s long-term objectives

  • Support the management of commercial contracts, vendor exploration, Proof-of-Concept documentation and Project Management

  • Understanding of compliance frameworks, particularly within the UK, EEA and the Americas, with a keen interest in regulatory compliance changes and divergence across markets

  • Analyze vendor performance against SLAs to drive improvements and decisioning

  • Identify and mitigate potential compliance risks to ensure robust and secure systems and processes

  • Legal / commercial Contract skills ; experience with contract negotiations

  • Technical Acumen: Familiarity with the technical architecture and solutions involved in KYC, POA, KYB and other Regtech solutions

  • Compliance experience: Knowledge of regulatory requirements, particularly in sectors such as financial services, hospitality, or technology.

  • Account Management Skills: Demonstrated ability to support complex partner relationships, service reviews, and align with business goals
